name: script-run-failing-step
description: runScript on a script whose second step's assertVisible has no match fails gracefully: the step is reported ok:false, the run stops there, and runCompleted (not runErrored) still fires with ok:false. This is the graceful-failure counterpart to script-run-stopped's runErrored path.

params.yaml:
appId: com.example.app
name: missing element
env: {}
---
- launchApp
- assertVisible: Nonexistent
